query:
SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
intent: Number of customers and January revenue per city, including cities with no paid orders
schema: customers(id, city), one row per customer; orders(id, customer_id, amount, status, created_at timestamp), one row per order
